key_insights: Altcoins have significantly underperformed Bitcoin this cycle, with Bitcoin dominance in up-only mode
No new outside capital flowing into altcoins, only crypto-native money slushing around
Meme coins absorbing liquidity and money leaving ecosystem rather than rotating through broader altcoin market
Support levels that have been tested multiple times (like ETH $2800-$3000) become increasingly risky to buy
Meme coin meta has become very short-lived with rapid cycles of pumps and rugs
Retail participation in 2024 is muted compared to previous cycles despite Bitcoin at all-time highs
Money has shifted from crypto gambling to traditional markets like sports betting and options trading
First test of support levels is generally better risk-reward than third/fourth tests

summary: The episode discusses a challenging market environment where Bitcoin has significantly outperformed altcoins, with BTC dominance rising and no evidence of altseason. Altcoins lack new buyers as money flows primarily into BTC and select meme coins. Major assets like ETH are testing critical support levels ($2800-$3000) that become riskier with multiple tests. Duck remains bullish on DOGE long-term and is scaling into positions around $0.10. Cred sees opportunity in SOL at current support but is bearish on WIF after it broke key levels. Both hosts agree the broader altcoin market remains weak compared to Bitcoin.
